description: Delete one of your client aliases permanently, along with its slots. Any request still naming "client:<brand>/<leaf>" afterwards is refused — it does NOT fall back to a SpiderIQ alias or to our pool. If you may want it back, call gate_client_alias_update with enabled=false instead: a disabled alias keeps its chain and its history. Requires the admin role.

name.description: The short leaf of the alias to delete.

name: gate_client_alias_delete
